source: editing conventions, NOT measured. A style pack with measured recipes overrides these.

curves.out-cubic: fast start, soft landing. The everyday entrance
curves.out-quint: very fast start, long gentle settle. Hero entrances, big objects
curves.in-cubic: slow start, fast end. Exits only
curves.in-out-cubic: smooth both ends. Moves inside a scene, camera
curves.out-back-soft: small overshoot then settle. Pops, badges, buttons
curves.bounce-soft: a gentle bounce on landing. Playful or light topics only
curves.bounce-out: full bounce. Rare, comedy or toy-like moments
curves.linear: constant speed. Spinners and loops only
curves.custom: a keyframe may carry [x1,y1,x2,y2] to tune a curve to the moment

exit.note: about 60 percent of the entrance length

emphasis.limit: once per scene, light topics only

timing: stagger grouped items 0.06 to 0.12 s apart, never all at once
bigger or farther moves take longer; small moves stay quick
at most one bouncy move per scene; none on serious or dark topics
never the same curve and timing on every object in a scene
land a move on a spoken word or a beat, not between them
a short hold after a move settles lets the eye read it
an optional anticipation (a tiny pull back, about 0.1 s) before a big push
pack_override: measured recipes in the active style pack replace these defaults
